To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) students' attitudes toward physics were more positive after the game-based learning intervention, and (2) students' physics knowledge and conceptual understanding were not significantly improved by the intervention.

(i) the use of games in physics instruction is effective in improving students' understanding of physics concepts; and (ii) the use of the game-based instruction method is a useful tool in the development of physics instruction.
the use of games in teaching Physics is an active and pleasant way to learn.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a methodology of active learning in which the students are involved in the construction of a game.
a methodology that involves students in creating and using games as an active learning strategy for physics education.
a methodology for the teaching and learning of Physics that uses games as an active strategy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of games as teaching-learning strategy is an effective method to promote the learning process of physics, and that the construction of games by students is an effective way of learning the basic physics concepts, in an active and pleasant way.

(i) games are a powerful tool for the teaching-learning of science; (ii) games are an excellent strategy for teaching science to adolescents; (iii) games can be a powerful tool in the teaching of physics; and (iv) games are a good strategy for teaching physics to students in the middle school.
The use of active methodologies in teaching and learning is a way of promoting the student's participation and engagement in the learning process.
